metadata.title: The Ergodicity of Geodesic Flows on Rank One Manifolds of Nonpositive Curvature
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the ergodicity of the geodesic flows on closed rank one manifolds of nonpositive sectional curvature. We introduce a subset of the manifold defined by the infinite-order vanishing of the Gaussian curvature in dimension two, or of the fiberwise second moment of the reduced Jacobi determinant in arbitrary dimensions, and derive bounds on the Liouville measure and Hausdorff dimension of the singular set in terms of this subset. In particular, if this subset has zero volume, then the singular set has zero Liouville measure, and the geodesic flow is ergodic with respect to Liouville measure. By extending this method to real analytic metrics, we characterize the singular set as the set of zeros of a nontrivial real analytic determinant constructed from curvature operators, thereby establishing ergodicity in this setting without any additional assumptions.

analysis.workSummary: 作者用曲率或约化 Jacobi 行列式矩的无限阶消失集合控制闭秩一非正曲率流形的奇异集，并声称由实解析性推出 Liouville 测地流遍历性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把特殊退化集合的体积条件转为动力学遍历性，并处理实解析度量。
analysis.limitations: 一般光滑情形仍有零体积条件；不可表述为所有闭秩一非正曲率度量均已解决。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 触及非正曲率几何与动力系统的重要交界，证明中奇异集控制值得核查。
